cs.t: I don't know how much of a glowing recommendation I can make but you might like beer more so than water plus you might be more careful with it and not spill it next time ;) As for keyboards & mice I've been using vintage for so long until now for a few devices where some interesting products got my attention from the Macally and X9-Performance brands:  https://us.macally.com/   https://x9performance.com  Never heard of them until they showed up as overstock for cheap, but they are decent. I like the bluetooth keyboard for my phone.  Also have mouse in bluetooth.  Plus the backlit large-print keyboard is really good for typing in low light.  And the compact keyboards without the numeric keypad save space, especially when it's more of a workbench than a desk.  There can be some funky key arrangements but lots of them are cross-platform between PC and Mac. It can also be good having the mouse with a variable DPI button. To move up a notch a fairly entry-level Logitech gaming mouse will give better resolution in the office even if you are not gaming.
